behavior: Social, diurnal ground forager; walks or runs in flocks while scratching for nuts, seeds, berries, insects, and other small prey. Flies short distances to tree roosts at night. Displaying males strut, lower their wings, fan their tails, and gobble.
field_marks: Very large, heavy-bodied bird with a long neck, long pinkish-gray legs, and a small head
Dark brown plumage with bronze-green iridescence and fine pale barring
Bare blue-gray head, dark eye, and short pale horn-colored bill
Adult male shows red throat wattles and often a dark breast beard
Dark, rounded wings boldly barred with white
Broad, rounded tail tipped rusty brown or whitish and fanned by displaying males
habitat: Mature hardwood and mixed conifer-hardwood forests interspersed with clearings, fields, grassland edges, orchards, and seasonal marshes.
